Main application entry points typically initialize logging frameworks and handle global debug configurations.
Core application class likely includes logging setup and utility methods for debugging.
Heap monitoring tools often include debug logging to track memory usage and related events.
Persistence management typically logs operations for debugging data storage and retrieval processes.
